thread:
tess: Noticed a small recurrence of delayed-token ingestion during the maintenance window. Opening thread to track remediation, owners, and follow-up cadence. billing-bot: Alert: detected 7 accounts with missing tokens, approx 42,750 tokens total.
maria: Thanks. Can we treat this as a postmortem follow-up item and include timeline + owners for billing adjustments?
aj: Assign a short-term owner for the remediation run and a long-term owner for recurrence prevention. Acceptance criteria should include ledger parity, backfill logs, and customer comms for >$150 credits.
sophie: I'll take short-term remediation this round. Plan: run targeted ledger sweep + backfill job bf-10011, reconcile, and produce a CSV of invoice diffs. ETA tomorrow AM.
ops-rotation: Assigned remediation rotation: week-of-2024-11-04 -> owner=tess. Add to rotation calendar.
tess: I'll coordinate the run and hand off to Dan for reconciliation. Will run in 10-min chunks to avoid compaction windows. Dry-run first.
billing-bot: Backfill job queued: job_id=bf-10011 status=pending region=ap-south estimate=25m.
sophie: Command I'll use (dry-run):
```
./metering/sweep --job bf-10011 --chunk=10m --dry-run --log-level=info
```
If dry-run looks good, flip to live with --apply.
maria: For customer comms: draft templates prepared. Auto-credit threshold = <$150. Anything above routes to finance review and Sales touch. Lex from Sales to approve enterprise notes.
aj: Add a note to incident tracker linking to recurrence heatmap and frequency analysis. We need to know if this is increasing or staying steady. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/pm-523.
tess: I'll attach a recurrence heatmap output to the postmortem doc after the run. Also creating a small rubric for automated credits vs manual review.
sophie: Quick infra note: compaction contention is likely root cause; infra PR to add index and adjust compaction schedule is in review: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/2611. If PR isn't merged, we'll prefer chunked runs outside compaction windows.
ops-rotation: Long-term owner for recurrence prevention = infra/SRE (sre-infra). Scheduling a 3-week follow-up checkpoint to confirm index rollout and compaction tuning.
maria: Timeline recap: Sophie (backfill run) tomorrow AM dry-run -> live if clean, Tess (coord) owner of rotation this week, Dan (reconcile) to produce ledger-diff and invoice-candidates, Maria (comms) to finalize templates and notify Sales.
aj: Acceptance criteria reiterated: ledger parity (0 token delta), backfill logs uploaded, invoice diff CSV attached, customer comms ready for any impacted >$150, and incident tracker updated with recurrence label.
sophie: Will update this thread with job ids, chunk logs, and final deltas. If we see >$1k aggregate per account, we'll pause automation and escalate.
billing-bot: Backfill started: job_id=bf-10011 chunk=1/3 status=running region=ap-south.
tess: Posting runbook + minimal rollback steps in the postmortem doc now. Rollback = stop job, revert partial commits with snapshot restore command:
```
./metering/restore --snapshot=snap-2024-11-04 --target=ledger
```
Only to be used if reconcile shows corruption (unlikely).
maria: Good. Also let's add a weekly metering-watch report to SRE cadence so we can spot trend shifts earlier. Assigning to ops-rotation to own initial run.
ops-rotation: Will produce weekly metering-watch report and include recurrence heatmap + top 10 affected accounts. First report due next Monday.
sophie: First chunk completed; dry-run looks clean, moving to chunk 2 now. Will report final token delta when done. :hourglass:
